review: Independent review of offline bundled pip bootstrap repair

findings.trigger: Default npm launcher bootstrap on Windows with global/site pip configuration present.
findings.evidence: Actual Node os.devNull JSON value is \\.\nul; actual Python os.devnull is nul. Equality is false. Seeded pip 25.0.1 configuration.py:247 disables config only on exact equality with os.devnull. Current launcher test runtime.test.js:423 asserts Node devNull and therefore mirrors the wrong string.
findings.impact: Global/site pip configuration remains active, contradicting the claimed installer isolation. Options such as target/prefix may redirect trusted offline pip installation and configured alternate sources remain active in later installs. No exploit executed; exact configuration-disable gap confirmed.
findings.minimal_repair: Use platform() === win32 ? nul : /dev/null for PIP_CONFIG_FILE, matching Python os.devnull, and assert that sentinel in the launcher regression. Retain isolated/offline/hash guards.

accepted_boundaries.assessment: One locked pip package exactly matches bootstrap dependency group. Locked URL must identify universal pip wheel on files.pythonhosted.org. Cached/downloaded content must match exact SHA256 and size before staging. Export includes bootstrap group with locked hashed requirements. Manifest includes bootstrap identity and wheel hash.

Manifest requires exact safe bootstrap basename and exact three-file inventory plus manifest; verifies each SHA256 before runtime setup. Full manifest fingerprint changes runtime directory identity, invalidating old ready runtimes.

First installer operation is offline no-index/no-deps against manifest-verified local pip wheel; later commands invoke patched installed pip for hashed binary application dependencies, offline ownwheel, and dependency check. Existing disable-version-check and Python isolated mode remain.
bootstrap pip==26.2.1; uv.lock contains matching wheel SHA256 71138adf1f4ca900cdb7d289c21b7494329f2332b6d85f0e1c42108c0384ed3e and size1816632. Version is above all six prior advisory fixes.

test_review.python: test_bootstrap_pip_uses_exact_lock_and_rejects_tampering covers trusted download, cached reuse, corrupted content rejection and mismatched group rejection.
test_review.launcher: Bootstrap wheel tampering/missing metadata rejects before setup. Concurrent setup test asserts offline-first order and preserves hash/binary/dependency guards. Configuration sentinel assertion must be corrected.
test_review.execution: Reviewer did not run tests, audits, benchmarks or package installation.

qualification: Do not final-freeze installed-artifact qualification until Windows sentinel is corrected. Fresh actual launcher runtime and wheel runtime inventories must include pip and be audited without advisory exclusions. New source/evidence binding needed after correction.
limitations: Review is static except a read-only Node/Python platform-string probe.
Source may change after these individual file hashes; no broad final input freeze asserted.
